name: game-catalog-navigation
goal: Keep Game Views reachable without overlapping catalog controls at every declared viewport.

steps.title: Identify the failing behavior, expected behavior, and reproduction.
steps.evidence: Fresh mobile catalog pixels show the eighth Game Views tab sharing the reserved search/settings slot. All seven app categories and both controls must remain reachable; normal app navigation must retain its layout.

steps.title: Explain why existing standardized tests missed the bug; name the scenario, fixture, lifecycle or assertion gap and reusable test change.
steps.evidence: The standard game-native authoring matrix only asserted the returned Game Views link was visible. Extend that same catalog state to assert no control overlap and follow the link back to the saved current game, preserving the earlier historical read-only checks, retaining declared captures before assertions.

steps.title: Strengthen the existing standardized test; commit it before repair, run it failing with loop record --phase red, and preserve the assertion.
steps.evidence: Sealed red0c1b59e21 recorddeaa50843afd uses the standard native matrix: desktop/tablet4pass, mobile2fail specifically at Game Views must not overlap catalog search or settings. Retains54 original screenshots with342 unit bindings and816 canonical observations. The earlier744 diagnostic used an incorrect readonly return expectation and is not adopted.

steps.title: Implement the smallest repair without weakening the regression test.
steps.evidence: Opus5.5 applies grid-column1 only to the conditional Game Views anchor. Mobile grid gives it a separate row; wider flex layouts ignore grid placement. Existing comments and all seven categories remain. A shared-header variant review rule now requires control separation and activation.

steps.title: Rerun the same unchanged regression test at a separate fix commit with loop record --phase green; preserve passing proof.
steps.evidence: Paired red0c1b59e21 record206d0d7a5fcd and green7941550df recordfae95cc88b36 freeze1356 test/config inputs and identical profile24a08292. steps.title: Run relevant project checks and affected UI browser flows with fresh inspected screenshots and no unexpected browser errors; preserve diagnostics and keep pending until proof passes.
